rationale: Opt-in retrieval tunings (2026-10-28). Values were fixed before any measurement; selection between them happens on the dev split only. The two *-selected aliases are the only entries edited after a measurement step and say which dev result chose them. Production default stays baseline (EVENTLENS_RAG_RETRIEVAL_TUNING unset).

baseline.note: Frozen retrieval-policy.v3 behaviour: RRF weights 1:1, 3 spans/article, no overlap filter, article-major packing, no per-article cap on index branches, v3 branch freshness, BM25 boosts 3:1.5:1.

sel3.note: Selection only: overlap filter (>= 0.5 of the shorter span) + breadth-first packing, 3 spans/article; index branches unchanged.

div3.note: sel3 + per-article cap 3 on each index branch with one bounded backfill to depth 100.

div2.note: div3 with 2 chunks per article on branches and in the selection.

div-selected.note: Alias of the diversity profile chosen on dev in run r1 (2026-10-28): sel3 ties baseline on every dev metric; div3 loses 1/48 and div2 7/48 gold passages in the payload. See .omo/evidence/search-platform/retrieval-improvement/final-decision.md.

w1-0.note: div-selected, BM25 only (semantic weight 0: branch disabled, no query embedding).

w0-1.note: div-selected, semantic only (BM25 weight 0: branch disabled).

w1-1.note: div-selected, equal weights (same fusion as baseline).

w1-2.note: div-selected, semantic weighted 2x. Candidate only, never a default.

wrrf-selected.note: Alias of the weighting chosen on dev in run r2 (2026-10-28): w1-2 ties w1-1 on every payload metric (A nDCG +0.001, CI [-0.001,+0.003]); w1-0 and w0-1 lose gold passages. Equal weights kept. See final-decision.md.

fill6.note: wrrf-selected + fill pass up to 6 spans/article into budget left after every base span (base cap stays 3), article-major packing. Added after r2: every gold passage lost between candidates and payload was the 4th+ chunk of the rank-1 article (dev 1, test 6) while payloads used ~4.3k of 12k tokens; breadth-first packing lost 3 dev gold passages under a binding budget (r2, +r20).
